function CheckItemShouldRemove()
        local cur = os.time()
        if upload_time == nil then
            return true
        end
        local upload = upload_time or 0
        local random = upload_time / 1000 % 100
        local time_diff = cur - upload / 1000
        local day_diff = time_diff / 86400
        if day_diff < 7 then
            return false
        end
        if day_diff < 14 then
            if random < 35 then
                return true
            else 
                return false
            end
        end
        if day_diff < 30 then
            if random < 40 then
                return true
            else 
                return false
            end
        end
        if day_diff < 60 then
            if random < 50 then
                return true
            else 
                return false
            end
        end
        if day_diff < 90 then
            if random < 60 then
                return true
            else 
                return false
            end
        end
        if day_diff < 120 then
            if random < 68 then
                return true
            else 
                return false
            end
        end
        if day_diff >= 120 then
            if random < 80 then
                return true
            else 
                return false
            end
        end
        return true
    end
